output:
To: @mia
Replying to: i04
Cc: none
Subject: none

Sorry I went quiet on you, I've been flat out at work and should've checked in properly. You drove out to Gatton at 2am when my car died, so you're not doing this on your own.

I'm off all day tomorrow now because Sam took my shift. I'll head to Priya's and get your stuff out of her garage before you have to leave. Just send me the address and whatever's bagged up and we'll sort the rest. Mum and Dad say we can borrow the trailer whenever, and Mum says she's thinking of you.

Ruby says you can crash on their couch for as long as you need. Fair warning, Clover will try to sleep on you.

Tully's sorted a benefit night at the Lantern Room on Sat the 28th, and all the door money goes to you. Jono's mates in Hollow Pines are playing too. Also, Jono's cousin has an old Yamaha keyboard in his shed that you can have to tide you over. It's not a Nord but it works.

Don't move back to Rocky, not like this. You're wrecked and it's been a rough few days. Let us help, and don't make any big calls this week. Your songs are the best thing about our band and you're not quitting on us.
